note: Literature establishes KLHL20 in neurodevelopmental disorder with facial dysmorphism and investigates facial phenotyping in ASD cohorts identifying this gene.

evidence.text: KLHL20 was identified as a novel gene for a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by intellectual disability and facial dysmorphism in studies evaluating next-generation sequencing and facial phenotyping in autism spectrum disorders.
